lines.en: Lesson 30
lines.zh: 第30课

lines.en: Exploring the sea-floor
lines.zh: 探索海底

lines.en: How did people probably imagine the sea-floor before it was investigated?
lines.zh: 在海底被勘测之前，人们可能如何想象它？

lines.en: Our knowledge of the oceans a hundred years ago was confined to the two-dimensional shape of the sea surface
lines.zh: 一百年前，我们对海洋的了解仅限于海面的二维形状

lines.en: and the hazards of navigation presented by the irregularities in depth of the shallow water close to the land.
lines.zh: 以及陆地附近浅水区深度不规则所带来的航行危险。

lines.en: The open sea was deep and mysterious,
lines.zh: 开阔的海洋深邃而神秘，

lines.en: and anyone who gave more than a passing thought to the bottom confines of the oceans probably assumed that the sea-bed was flat.
lines.zh: 任何对海洋底部边界稍加思考的人可能都认为海床是平坦的。

lines.en: Sir James Clark Ross had obtained a sounding of over 2, 400 fathoms in 1839,
lines.zh: 詹姆斯·克拉克·罗斯爵士于1839年测得超过2400噚的深度，

lines.en: but it was not until 1869, when H.M.S. Porcupine was put at the disposal of the Royal Society for several cruises
lines.zh: 但直到1869年，当“豪猪号”军舰被皇家学会征用进行数次航行时，

lines.en: that a series of deep soundings was obtained in the Atlantic and the first samples were collected by dredging the bottom.
lines.zh: 才在大西洋获得了一系列深海探测数据，并通过海底拖网收集了第一批样本。

lines.en: Shortly after this the famous H.M.S. Challenger expedition established the study of the sea-floor
lines.zh: 此后不久，著名的“挑战者号”军舰远征队确立了海底研究

lines.en: as a subject worthy of the most qualified physicists and geologists.
lines.zh: 成为值得最合格的物理学家和地质学家研究的课题。

lines.en: A burst of activity associated with the laying of submarine cables
lines.zh: 随之而来的海底电缆铺设热潮

lines.en: soon confirmed the Challenger's observation that many parts of the ocean were two to three miles deep,
lines.zh: 很快证实了“挑战者号”的观测结果：海洋许多地方深达两到三英里，

lines.en: and the existence of underwater features of considerable magnitude.
lines.zh: 并存在着规模巨大的水下特征。

lines.en: Today, enough soundings are available to enable a relief map of the Atlantic to be drawn
lines.zh: 如今，已有的测深数据足以绘制出大西洋的浮雕地图，

lines.en: and we know something of the great variety of the sea bed's topography.
lines.zh: 我们对海底地形的巨大多样性有了一定的了解。

lines.en: Since the sea covers the greater part of the earth's surface,
lines.zh: 由于海洋覆盖了地球表面的大部分，

lines.en: it is quite reasonable to regard the sea floor as the basic form of the crust of the earth,
lines.zh: 将海底视为地壳的基本形态是相当合理的，

lines.en: with superimposed upon it the continents,
lines.zh: 大陆、

lines.en: together with the islands and other features of the oceans.
lines.zh: 以及岛屿和海洋的其他特征都叠加其上。

lines.en: The continents form rugged tablelands which stand nearly three miles above the floor of the open ocean.
lines.zh: 大陆形成了崎岖不平的高原，它们比开阔海洋的海底高出近三英里。

lines.en: From the shore line, out to a distance which may be anywhere from a few miles to a few hundred miles,
lines.zh: 从海岸线向外延伸，距离可能从几英里到几百英里不等，

lines.en: runs the gentle slope of the continental shelf, geologically part of the continents.
lines.zh: 是大陆架的平缓斜坡，它在地质学上属于大陆的一部分。

lines.en: The real dividing line between continents and oceans occurs at the foot of a steeper slope.
lines.zh: 大陆和海洋的真正分界线出现在一个更陡峭的斜坡底部。

lines.en: This continental slope usually starts at a place somewhere near the 100-fathom mark
lines.zh: 这个大陆坡通常始于100噚标记附近的某个地方，

lines.en: and in the course of a few hundred miles reaches the true ocean floor at 2, 500-3, 500 fathoms.
lines.zh: 并在几百英里的延伸中到达2500-3500噚的真正海底。

lines.en: The slope averages about 1 in 30, but contains steep,
lines.zh: 该斜坡平均坡度约为1:30，但包含陡峭的、

lines.en: probably vertical, cliffs, and gentle sediment-covered terraces,
lines.zh: 可能是垂直的悬崖，以及平缓的被沉积物覆盖的阶地，

lines.en: and near its lower reaches there is a long tailing-off which is almost certainly the result of
lines.zh: 在其下部区域，有一个长长的逐渐减缓的坡段，这几乎肯定是由于

lines.en: material transported out to deep water after being eroded from the continental masses.
lines.zh: 物质从大陆块体被侵蚀后输送到深水区的结果。
